startup: Procedural spinner independent of TF/SDRAM; min 96 video frames; validated first frame; initial extra 1 s hold; original GIF playback
prior_hardware_observation: ReadAlign cb6d2261: user reports d4 E39, spinner only, LED1 off; pages 0..5 give expected/upload/readback CRC EA54DD20 identically, so full cache gate passed on hardware
fix: QuadWrite: aligned four-word bursts, mask untouched words and coalesce contiguous patches; completion waits for bus drain; retain read/cache gates; verify pre-read and consumed encoded CRC; E31..E38 diagnostics; SDRAM shift advanced from 8 ns to 7 ns for setup margin
root_cause: Old patch bus definitely violated APUG011 four-word addressing/mask contract; old code rejection reproduced. This is a concrete defect, but its causal relation to physical E39 and the playback result still require board validation
official_reference: APUG011 v1.2 sections 2.3.4, 2.4 and 3; supplied sdr_wrrd.enc.v matches reference design SHA256 c7d7fe07d75f66aa88d9f986b3006319c995162434f104f9990664b374cdfdd2

tests.decoder: all 27 frames plus loop delta; both buffers; invalid streams
tests.pipeline: Four original presentations with native FIFOs/raster; exact pixels, strict four-word writes and masks, ten-cycle SDRAM model
tests.budget: Full original loop and pause/resume; real clock-rate video demand; encoded stream CRC, strict four-word writes and masks, ten-cycle SDRAM model
tests.boot: No-TF spinner/rotation/dwell; first-frame RGB565/black border; later buffer commit
tests.status: Fault priorities, word/CRC pages, debounced key; automatic BIST/decoder/CRC pages and code restoration without SW2/KEY1
tests.first_hold: Additional first-image hold followed by original schedule
tests.cache: Upload CRC, BIST, E2A..E2F injections, full CRC E29; native command FIFO and 100/50 MHz upload FIFO; early-data model reproduces E2D, previous-cycle capture passes CRC/index/tails/boundaries and fault rejection
tests.stream_crc: Pre-read CRC E37, invalid decoded command E33 and structurally valid changed stream E38 block publication
tests.patch_quads: 111 words/all lanes/boundaries; four aligned beats, masks, contiguous coalescing, drain, neighbors preserved, active-frame guard; old one-beat implementation rejected

limits: Encrypted SDRAM controller and HDMI PHY require physical board validation; TF raw sectors require contiguous file
strategy: TD 6.2.168116; seed12; original frequencies; SDRAM shift 7 ns/126 degrees; pack_seq_in_io off

hardware_observation.scope: User reports successful board result after delivery; no independent long-duration hardware measurements were performed.
